name: @dgabehar/k8s-discovery-client
description: Shared in-cluster K8s-API-over-HTTPS+Bearer primitives (fresh ServiceAccount-token read, CA-pinned fetch, K8s label/name sanitization, output-allowlisting parse helper), extracted from opencode-agent-harness/bridge/src/discovery.ts and fleet-console/src/k8s-enumerate.ts. No kubectl binary, no @kubernetes/client-node dependency -- Bun/Node's native fetch already supports the per-request tls: { ca, rejectUnauthorized } override this needs.
